L8: Introduction
L9: 
L10: [Button: Previous] Next
L11: Thank you for purchasing Pac-Man.
L12: Pac-Man first appeared in arcades in 1980.
L13: This version is a faithful recreation of the original, with additional options that let you adjust screen and sound settings for a truly authentic experience.
L14: Adored the world over, Pac-Man was awarded a Guinness World Record in 2005 as the most successful coin-operated arcade machine in history. We hope you enjoy playing!
L15: 
L16: How to Play
L17: 
L18: [Button: Previous] Next
L19: ## How to Play
L20: 
L21: Move Pac-Man up, down, left, and right and eat all the Pac-Dots to advance to the next stage.
L22: You will lose a life if Pac-Man is caught by a ghost.
L23: 
L24: ## Turn the Tables With a Power Pellet!
L25: 
L26: When you eat a Power Pellet, the ghosts will turn blue and Pac-Man will be able to eat them.
L27: The Power Pellet's effect only lasts for a short time.
L28: ## Earning a High Score
L29: 
L30: Eat multiple blue ghosts in succession before the Power Pellet's effect runs out to rack up points.
L31: Fruit will appear once you eat a certain number of Pac-Dots.
L32: Eat the fruit to earn bonus points.
